subject: Urgent: elevated p95 breach — provisional mitigation & rollback clearance
messages:
From: laura.nguyen <laura@crescentpay.com>
To: jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: cto@crescentpay.com
Date: Fri, 27 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sharp p95 degradation affecting payments path (omega-gamma-v3)

Hi Jordan / Ben,

We started seeing a pronounced p95 jump in our production calls tied to model omega-gamma-v3 around 03:00 UTC this morning. Topline: p95 from ~420ms -> ~1.6s for requests with 1k+ tokens. Error rates are unchanged, but latency is causing timeouts in our end-to-end processing.

Attached is a 15-min window from our synthetic tests and traces. Our QoS thresholds require action — can Redwood do a variant fallback or traffic-split to the previous variant while you investigate? We need to avoid impacting our settlement pipeline during US business hours.

- Laura
Sr. Ops Eng, CrescentPay

Attachments: p95_spike_2028-07-27.png (image), traces_window_03-15.zip (referenced)
From: jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, laura.nguyen <laura@crescentpay.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Jul 2028 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sharp p95 degradation affecting payments path (omega-gamma-v3)

Thanks Laura — looping in infra and CS.

Quick context: CrescentPay is on a committed Dedicated plan; SLA impact here is sensitive. Karthik / Monica — can you confirm whether this looks like a model-side regression (new weights/quant) or a serving/runtime regression? If this is variant-specific we should be able to split traffic to omega-gamma-v2 while you root cause.

Proposed provisional mitigation (pending engineering sign-off + leadership clearance):
- Immediate traffic split: 70% to v2, 30% to v3 for next 2h
- Enable prefix KV cache for CrescentPay routes for hot contexts (short-term)
- Collect latency profiles and sample logs (attach to ticket)

We will need an authorization note for rollback if v3 is confirmed as the cause. Ben / Marissa — can we get provisional approval to execute the 70/30 split and a fallback plan if p95 does not improve within 30 minutes?

Jordan Blake
Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura.nguyen <laura@crescentpay.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Jul 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sharp p95 degradation affecting payments path (omega-gamma-v3)

Investigated briefly — notes below.

Findings:
- Regression localized to omega-gamma-v3; can reproduce in canary with long-context synthetic traces.
- Root cause likely a recent quantization pass that altered attention kernel tiling for >512 tokens. On certain nvHPC nodes the kernel falls back to slower matmul path causing 3–4x latency for long sequences.
- No memory leaks or error spikes; correctness unaffected.

Recommended immediate actions:
1) Approve provisional traffic split (Jordan's 70/30) to mitigate customer impact.
2) Activate a fast fallback: pin CrescentPay to omega-gamma-v2 for all production traffic if split does not bring p95 under 700ms within 30 minutes.
3) Create a rollback authorization note (required by platform policy) signed by revenue owner + product lead for any full rollback.

Risk & notes:
- Rolling back v3 completely removes fixes for some prompt-safety micro-regressions; recommend a staged roll-forward after a patch.
- Traffic-split requires a short warm-up; expect brief transient variance in p50 while caches repopulate.

I can execute the traffic split as soon as I get explicit approval from Sales/Rev and a heads-up to SREs. Karthik
Sr. Software Engineer, Serving Runtime

Attachment: omega-gamma-v3-performance-summary.pdf
From: jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 17:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sharp p95 degradation affecting payments path (omega-gamma-v3) — provisional clearance granted

Laura — updating you and closing the loop.

Per Karthik's analysis and given CrescentPay's SLA exposure, we are approving the provisional mitigation plan:
- Execute traffic split now: 70% -> omega-gamma-v2, 30% -> omega-gamma-v3 (adaptive rollback criteria active).
- If p95 for CrescentPay remains >700ms after 30 minutes, we will fully pin to omega-gamma-v2; Karthik will perform the change.
- CS and SRE will monitor and report 5-min cadence until normalized.

Ben / Marissa — this email functions as the revenue-owner provisional authorization for the traffic split and conditional rollback. Please reply-all with explicit approval if you want us to proceed beyond the provisional window (full rollback).

Action items:
- Karthik: execute 70/30 split and open INC (linked).
- Monica: stand up monitoring dashboard and share link.
- Ben/Marissa: approve extension or full rollback if needed.

Thanks — Jordan
